newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Downer ups Century offer to A$1.60/shr.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Downer ups Century offer to A$1.60/shr.

text.p: Downer Group Australia Pty Ltd, a unit of Paul Y-Construction Holdings Ltd, said on Tuesday it had raised its takeover offer for drilling contractor Century Drilling Ltd to A$1.60 a share form A$1.02 per share.
"The offer of an additional 58 cents per share is conditional upon Downer becoming entitled to not less than 50.1 percent of the ordinary shares in Century on or before 11 April 1997," Downer said.
"In the absence of a bid from a third party, Downer will not further increase its offer for Century," it said.
It said it proposed to extend the offer to April 14 to give shareholders enough time to consider the revised offer.
Downer said it believed the revised price was very generous as it represented 24.6 times 1995/96 earnings (diluted) and 14.0 times 1996/97 earnings (diluted) as forecast by Century.
It also represented 32.0 times Century's forecast unfranked dividend for 1996/97.
The A$1.60 per share offer also represented a 60 percent premium to Century's trading price prior to Downer's on-market purchases, Downer said.
The price was at a 99 percent premium to net assets per share as at 31 December.
"Furthermore, Downer believes that Century's share price is likely to fall materially in the event Downer's offer lapses."
Century's share price closed down five cents at A$1.27 on Monday and was untraded early on Tuesday.
Brierley Investments Ltd owns 23 percent of Paul Y, Downer's parent company.
